name: godspeed-coding-agent
description: Run Godspeed coding agent tasks from VS Code — send files, selections, and diffs to godspeed run.

commands.title: Godspeed: Run Task
commands.description: Send editor selection or a prompted task to godspeed run

commands.title: Godspeed: Explain Selection
commands.description: Ask Godspeed to explain the current editor selection

commands.title: Godspeed: Review Diff
commands.description: Run a review-style prompt against git diff output

commands.title: Godspeed: Resume Session
commands.description: Open an integrated terminal running godspeed --continue

godspeed.executablePath.description: Path to the godspeed executable. Use an absolute path if godspeed is not on your PATH.

godspeed.defaultTimeout.description: Default wall-clock timeout in seconds for godspeed run (0 = no limit).

godspeed.model.description: Model override passed to godspeed run via --model. Leave empty to use the default model.
